input.summary: 200 microseconds and 0.2 milliseconds are exactly equal (1 ms = 1000 µs), so the two notes are consistent — no conflict exists. Workload size, budget, and delay placement remain unresolved before a full proposal can be drafted.
clarification_questions: What transfer workload should each flow carry (e.g., file size in bytes or MB), and how many concurrent flows, if any, per replication?
Is the 20 ms delay value intended as a one-way (sender→receiver) or round-trip (both directions) placement in the netem emulation?
What are the resource or budget constraints for this pilot — specifically, how many total replications are acceptable and is there a wall-time or cost ceiling?
